canonical_statement: For every elliptic curve E over a number field K, polarization of the normalized Neron-Tate canonical height defines a symmetric Z-bilinear real pairing on E(K), with self-pairing equal to the height, nonnegative diagonal, diagonal kernel exactly the torsion points, and a positive-definite descended pairing on E(K) modulo torsion.
domain_and_universes: universe u; K : Type u; Field K; DecidableEq K; NumberField K; E : WeierstrassCurve K; E.IsElliptic; P Q R : E(K); m n : Int
conclusion: Nonempty (NeronTatePairingPackage K E), retaining the normalized canonical-height limit, bounded comparison, polarization by one half, symmetry, additivity and integer scalar laws in both arguments, diagonal identity and torsion kernel, and the positive-definite quotient pairing.
pairing_normalization: pairing P Q = (canonicalHeight (P + Q) - canonicalHeight P - canonicalHeight Q) / 2; self_pairing fixes pairing P P = canonicalHeight P.
height_normalization: xHeight P is Height.logHeight P.xRep; the canonical-height sequence is 4^(-n) * xHeight([2^n]P) / 2 and the bounded comparison is with xHeight/2.
quotient_encoding: The quotient is E(K) / AddCommGroup.torsion E(K). quotient_lift freezes agreement on representatives, and quotient_positive_definite states nonnegativity and zero only at the quotient identity.
minimal_import_check: Affine.Point supplies elliptic rational points, their commutative group and quotient substrate, xRep, and scalar actions. Height.NumberField supplies NumberField, logarithmic height, real topology, and the convergence vocabulary. Neither import is redundant for this exact expression.
